info.name: VegaMart — Maintenance Control
info.description:
Control VegaMart maintenance mode with browser links.

Endpoints:
  * GET  /api/v1/system/maintenance/status — public flag + message (no auth)
  * GET  /api/v1/system/maintenance/on?token=...     — enable maintenance (message 'Contact the developer')
  * GET  /api/v1/system/maintenance/off?token=...    — disable maintenance

If MAINTENANCE_TOGGLE_TOKEN is not configured, the toggles are restricted to requests from the server itself (localhost). The /system namespace and /health endpoints are excluded from the maintenance gate.

request.description: Publicly readable maintenance flag and message. No auth required. Served even while maintenance mode is active.

Turns on maintenance mode with the message 'Contact the developer'. Pasteable in a browser. All requests except /health, /metrics, /docs and /system/* will receive HTTP 503 with { maintenance: true, message }.
Turns off maintenance mode and restores normal API access. Pasteable in a browser.
